sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English podcast. I am Emily. Today we will talk about
Sophia. Sophia is the capital city of Bulgaria. It is in the western part of the country near
mountains. Sophia is famous for its history, churches and green parks. The city is big,
busy and full of life. People enjoy walking in the streets and visiting old buildings.
Part two, where is Sophia? Sophia is in western Bulgaria near the Vitosha mountain.
Part it is not far from the border with Serbia and north Macedonia. The city is in a valley with
rivers and parks around it. Sophia is the largest city in Bulgaria and the center of culture,
business and government. Part three, a short history of Sophia. Sophia is very old.
People have lived here for more than 7,000 years. It was part of the Roman Empire,
the Ottoman Empire and Bulgaria. Many old buildings and churches show the history of Sophia.
Today, Sophia is modern but it keeps its traditions and history alive. Part four,
landmarks of Sophia. Sophia has many landmarks. One famous place is the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral,
a big church with golden domes. Another is the Boyana Church with old paintings and decorations.
You can also see the National Palace of Culture, a big modern building for events.
Each landmark tells the story about Sophia's past and present.
Part five, Vitosha Mountain. Vitosha Mountain is near Sophia. People go there to hike, ski and
enjoy nature. In winter, there is snow for skiing. In summer, people hike and have picnics.
From the top of the mountain, you can see the whole city. Nature is very important for life in Sophia.
Part six, parks and green spaces. Sophia has many parks and gardens.
Borosova gradina is a big park with trees, flowers, and walking paths. People relax, jog,
and play sports in the parks. Green spaces make the city fresh and calm.
Part seven, food and Sophia. Food and Sophia is tasty and simple. People eat meat, vegetables,
bread, and dairy. A popular dish is Bonnica, a pastry with cheese and eggs. Other foods include
Shopska salad, yogurt, and grilled meat. People enjoy cafes, restaurants, and street food.
Part eight, markets and shopping. Sophia has many markets and shops. Central Market Hall is famous
for food, vegetables, and souvenirs. People also enjoy shopping in modern malls. Markets are colorful,
busy, and full of local life. Part nine, people of Sophia. People in Sophia are friendly and
hardworking. Many speak Bulgarian and some speak English. People enjoy family, music, and culture.
They celebrate traditional festivals and modern events. People are proud of their city and history.
Part 10, weather and Sophia. The weather in Sophia has four seasons. Winter is cold with snow.
Spring is warm with flowers. Summer is sunny and hot. Autumn is colorful with leaves.
People enjoy outdoor activities in all seasons. The weather changes the feeling of the city.
Part 11, culture and festivals. Sophia has many cultural events. The Sophia International Film
Festival and music festivals are very popular. People enjoy theater, concerts, and art exhibitions.
Culture is important for the people and makes the city lively. Part 12, goodbye from Sophia.
culture, mountains, and parks. You can walk in old streets, visit churches, eat delicious food,
and enjoy nature. It is a city full of life, beauty, and traditions. I hope you can visit
Sophia one day and see its charm. Goodbye. Or as people say in Bulgarian, dovishdani.
